artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer verification of the cubic identities, the published fifth- and ninth-power valuation formulas on finite ranges, and the normalized recurrences.

limitations: Only \(m=3,5,9\) are proved; the all-exponent conjecture is not settled. No minimal automata or state-complexity bounds are given. Full text of the recent Shen conjecture paper was not independently retrieved during this audit.
provenance: Scientific record; fresh independent mathematical assessment completed on 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: Automatic odd parts for the cubic, fifth and ninth Thue-Morse powers
scientific_context: Proves the automatic-odd-part conjecture for the previously uncovered exponents \(m=3,5,9\) by finite-state reductions built from coefficient and valuation recurrences.
